overview: CharlieSierra is a decentralized, end-to-end encrypted secure messaging platform with full PWA support for installation on desktop and mobile devices.
features: Installable PWA for desktop and mobile
Offline app shell with friendly messaging
Push notifications for group requests and admin actions
Web app manifest with CharlieSierra branding
Auto-updating service worker with asset caching
Install App button in Settings and header
Dark mode support in installed mode
